scenarios.title: A spell with sneak can be cast during the declare blockers step by returning an unblocked creature
decisions: A attacks player B with Hill Giant.
In the declare blockers step A casts Leonardo, Big Brother using sneak: pays {W} by tapping Plains and returns the unblocked Hill Giant to A's hand.
Both players pass; Leonardo, Big Brother resolves.

variants.label: unblocked_attacker
variants.expected: Casting Leonardo, Big Brother for the sneak cost is legal. Hill Giant moves from the battlefield to A's hand and Leonardo, Big Brother enters the battlefield.

variants.label: attacker_blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Hill Giant with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Casting Leonardo, Big Brother for the sneak cost is not legal: A controls no unblocked creature to return, and {W} alone cannot pay the mana cost {2}{W}. Leonardo stays in A's hand.

variants.label: before_blockers
variants.delta: A tries to cast Leonardo, Big Brother by sneak in the declare attackers step, before blockers are declared.
variants.expected: Casting for the sneak cost is not legal: it is not the declare blockers step. Leonardo stays in A's hand and Hill Giant stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A permanent spell cast for its sneak cost enters tapped and attacking the same defender as the returned creature

setup.notes: Jace Beleren has 3 loyalty. Leonardo, Big Brother is a 1/3 that gets +1/+0 for each other creature A controls.

decisions: A attacks player B with Hill Giant.
In the declare blockers step A casts Leonardo, Big Brother using sneak: pays {W} by tapping a Plains and returns the unblocked Hill Giant to A's hand.
Both players pass; Leonardo, Big Brother resolves.
Both players pass; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: attacking_player
variants.expected: Leonardo, Big Brother enters tapped and attacking B. Hill Giant is in A's hand. Leonardo (1/3, no other creatures) deals 1 combat damage to B (19). Jace Beleren keeps 3 loyalty.

variants.label: attacking_planeswalker
variants.delta: Hill Giant attacks Jace Beleren instead of player B.
variants.expected: Leonardo, Big Brother enters tapped and attacking Jace Beleren. Leonardo deals 1 combat damage to Jace Beleren (loyalty 2). B's life stays 20.

variants.label: cast_normally
variants.delta: A casts Leonardo, Big Brother for its mana cost {2}{W} in the second main phase, tapping three Plains, instead of by sneak; Hill Giant stays on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Hill Giant deals 3 combat damage to B (17). Leonardo, Big Brother enters untapped and is not attacking.
